description: This file defines the 'Task' interface in the 'org.openmrs.scheduler' package, outlining methods for task execution, initialization, status checking, and cleanup within the OpenMRS scheduling subsystem.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Interface representing a schedulable task with methods to execute, initialize, retrieve task details, check execution state, and shutdown.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the task as defined in the task implementation.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the task with its associated task definition.

methods.name: getTaskDefinition
methods.description: Retrieves the task definition associated with this task.

methods.name: isExecuting
methods.description: Checks if the task is currently executing.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Performs cleanup and resource release after task execution.
